help: Activates the gate with the given id in the current system.
Lists faction-owned (non-neutral) systems as a tree of system, entities, and factions; flags cut-off systems and hidden/undiscovered markets.
Lists the current system's entities as an orbit tree (distance and speed per entity); unorbited entities then fleets follow with coordinates. 'gates' narrows to gates.

Spawns an entity at your fleet position in the current system, orbiting a focus (defaults to the system center; multi-star systems need an orbit_focus_id). With no explicit speed, the speed in deg/day is derived from the orbit radius to match vanilla's drift; an explicit speed=<deg/day> sets the base rate instead (<=0 pins it). jitter=<frac> (default 0.25) then widens whichever speed results, derived or explicit (pass jitter=0 for an exact speed). Focus and speed may be positional or named (focus=<id>, speed=<deg/day>); jitter is named-only. Kinds: 'gate' (inactive; activate with kmlib_activate_gate), 'jump_point' (generates its hyperspace entrance and clears the cut-off tag).
